definitions: To turn over with a sudden quick movement.
To move or toss something with a quick, light movement.
To become or make someone become very angry or lose control.
To change from one state or position to another, often suddenly.
To buy something with the intention of selling it quickly for a profit.
examples: He flipped the coin into the air.
She flipped through the pages of the book.
The news made him flip his lid.
The market flipped from bull to bear.
They flipped the house in just a few months.
